claims: The 2026 Masters continues on Saturday, April 11 with third-round coverage.
Third-round coverage of the 2026 Masters is on CBS from 2-7 p.m. ET on Saturday, April 11.
Paramount+ provides streaming preceding the CBS third-round coverage from 12-2 p.m. ET on Saturday, April 11.
Live coverage is available on Masters.com and the Masters App featuring Featured Groups and Amen Corner throughout Saturday, April 11.
CBS provides TV coverage for Round 3 from 2 p.m. to 7 p.m. ET on Saturday, April 11.
Paramount+ provides early streaming for Round 3 from 12 p.m. to 2 p.m. ET on Saturday, April 11.
All-day streaming for Round 3 is available on Masters.com, Masters App, Paramount+, and Amazon Prime Video.
Masters.com, Masters App, ESPN App, and Paramount+ offer streams for Amen Corner from 11:45 a.m. to 6 p.m. ET.
Masters.com, Masters App, ESPN App, and Paramount+ offer streams for Holes 15 & 16 from 11:45 a.m. to 7 p.m. ET.
CBS provides TV coverage for the final round from 2 p.m. to 7 p.m. ET on Sunday, April 12.
Paramount+ and Masters.com will provide full coverage options for streaming the final round.
Rory McIlroy leads after the second round of the 2026 Masters.
According to The Palm Beach Post, Rory McIlroy extended his lead to six shots in the second round.
Shane Lowry had a hole-in-one on the 6th hole.
